title: HOGi-Labs
description: A Core Mod for the HOGifactory modpack
body:
# WARNING!
This is a core mod for the HOGifactory modpack and probably shouldn't be installed on its own.  
Check the project out here: https://github.com/Horde-Of-Greg/HOGifactory

The project is also a WIP, and is not feature complete yet.

As it is meant to be used inside a pack, no item added by the mod has a recipe, except recipes auto generated by GregTech-CEu. 


# Content

This is a GregTech-CEu addon that adds many multiblocks centered around unique mechanics, whilst staying grounded. We are still going to add more and more Multiblocks as we go

## Multiblocks added: 

### Steel Blast Furnace
An upgrade to the Primitive Blast Furnace that has INFINITE parallel, but a flat recipe time of 1000s.

### Panner
A very simple multiblock that requires no energy, used to separate liquid from solid.

### Boostrapped Multiblocks
This is a family of multiblocks that use steam for power, have a certain amount of parallel and have a recipe tier of HV. Think of these as an upgrade to Steam Multis.
List of currently implemented bootstrapped multiblocks:
- Mixer

### Caterpillar Generator
An upgrade to the ECE, can use Fluorine as an even better booster than Oxygen to make up to 3A ZPM.

## Other
- Steam mixer singleblock.
- Tungsten Rhenium Coil. A replacement for HSS-G coils.
